provider.description: VCS provider. Use "auto" to detect github.com, gitlab.com, or dev.azure.com from the git remote. Custom domains require an explicit provider and a matching repository.<provider> sub-section.

pre_major_breaking_bumps_minor.description: Before 1.0.0, downgrade breaking changes from a major bump to a minor bump. Has no effect on calver targets.

pre_major_features_bump_patch.description: Before 1.0.0, downgrade minor-level bumps to patch. Applies to every commit type listed in bump_types.minor (default: feat), not only feat. Has no effect on calver targets.

version_files.description: Default version files for targets that do not override them.

repository.description: Repository coordinates. Set `remote` plus exactly one provider sub-section matching the top-level `provider`. If omitted, yeet auto-detects from the git remote. Custom domains require an explicit provider and the matching sub-section.

remote.description: Git remote name used for repository auto-detection when explicit coordinates are incomplete.

repository_github.description: GitHub repository coordinates. Used when provider is github.

host.description: GitHub host, such as github.com or a GitHub Enterprise hostname.

project.description: Project path in owner/repo form. Optional shorthand for owner+repo.

repository_gitlab.description: GitLab repository coordinates. Used when provider is gitlab.

host.description: GitLab host, such as gitlab.com or a self-hosted GitLab hostname.

project.description: Full GitLab project path, including any subgroups.

repository_azuredevops.description: Azure DevOps repository coordinates. Used when provider is azuredevops.

collection.description: Optional Azure DevOps collection. Defaults to the organization when omitted.

subject_include_branch.description: Include target branch in generated release subjects.

auto_merge.description: Automatically merge release PR/MR and finalize release in the same run.

auto_merge_force.description: Bypass yeet readiness checks for auto-merge attempts. Provider branch rules still apply.

pr_body_header.description: Optional markdown inserted before changelog in release PR/MR body.

pr_body_footer.description: Optional markdown appended after changelog in release PR/MR body.

channels.description: Named prerelease channels. Each channel runs only on its configured branch and creates semver prerelease versions.

oneOf.description: Repo-relative file path updated with comment-based yeet markers.
Version file update rule. Use format=json with json_pointer for JSON files that cannot contain comment markers.

format.description: How yeet locates the version value in the file.

json_pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the string version value. Required when format is json.

branch.description: Branch that owns this prerelease channel.

prerelease.description: Semver prerelease identifier, such as alpha, beta, or rc.

changelog_file.description: Optional channel changelog path. By default yeet derives CHANGELOG.<channel>.md from each target changelog file.

bump_types.description: Mapping of bump levels to conventional commit types. Types not listed produce no version bump. Breaking commits always bump major regardless of this mapping, subject to pre_major_breaking_bumps_minor before 1.0.0.

minor.description: Commit types that trigger a minor version bump.

patch.description: Commit types that trigger a patch version bump.

file.description: Repo-relative path to the changelog file that is created and updated on release.

include.description: Conventional commit types to include in changelog.

sections.description: Mapping of commit types to section headings.

references.description: Controls how issue/ticket references are linked in changelogs.

patterns.description: Regex patterns matched against commit descriptions. Matches are replaced inline with links using the URL template. Use {value} as placeholder for the matched text.

pattern.description: Regular expression to match issue references (e.g. "JIRA-\\d+").

url.description: URL template with {value} placeholder. Empty string renders as plain text.

footers.description: Mapping of commit footer keys to URL templates. Matched footers are appended after the commit hash. Use {value} as placeholder for the footer value. Empty string renders as plain text.

format.description: CalVer format template. Supports dot-separated YYYY, YY, 0Y, MM, 0M, WW, 0W, DD, 0D, and required final MICRO tokens. Week tokens cannot be combined with month or day tokens, and day tokens require a month token.

targets.description: Configured releasable targets in the repository.

path.description: Repo-relative path used for commit filtering.

tag_prefix.description: Stable tag namespace for this target.

versioning.description: Versioning strategy for this target. Overrides the top-level versioning setting.

pre_major_breaking_bumps_minor.description: Before 1.0.0, downgrade breaking changes from a major bump to a minor bump. Has no effect on calver targets.

pre_major_features_bump_patch.description: Before 1.0.0, downgrade minor-level bumps to patch. Applies to every commit type listed in bump_types.minor (default: feat), not only feat. Has no effect on calver targets.

version_files.description: Files whose version strings are updated on release. Overrides the top-level version_files for this target.

exclude_paths.description: Repo-relative paths excluded from this target's commit filtering. Must be inside the target's path.

path.description: Optional repo-relative path for direct commit filtering. When set, commits under this path contribute to the release in addition to commits from included path targets.

tag_prefix.description: Stable tag namespace for this target.

versioning.description: Versioning strategy for this target. Overrides the top-level versioning setting.

pre_major_breaking_bumps_minor.description: Before 1.0.0, downgrade breaking changes from a major bump to a minor bump. Has no effect on calver targets.

pre_major_features_bump_patch.description: Before 1.0.0, downgrade minor-level bumps to patch. Applies to every commit type listed in bump_types.minor (default: feat), not only feat. Has no effect on calver targets.

version_files.description: Files whose version strings are updated on release. Overrides the top-level version_files for this target.

exclude_paths.description: Repo-relative paths excluded from this target's commit filtering. Must be inside the target's path.

includes.description: Path target IDs included in this derived release.
